segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I saw the note that you’re planning the services team rollout for September 9. I wanted to confirm seats and the billing setup before we send the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that’s right. We’re starting with 42 seats, not 50. Twenty-eight are full users and 14 are view-only. If adoption is good, we may add the rest in Q4.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 42 total for the first order. On the current pricing sheet, that puts the annual subscription at $31,080, and implementation is the fixed $4,800 package we discussed. Does that line up with what you had budgeted?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It does. The only thing procurement asked is whether the invoice can show implementation as a separate line item, because it comes from a different cost center.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, that’s standard. The order form will show subscription and implementation separately, and billing can invoice them on the same invoice or split them. Which do you prefer?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: One invoice is fine, just two lines. And payment terms need to be net 30. Our default contract language says net 45, but for software this size net 30 is okay.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, net 30. Term would be September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027, so you’ve got a few days before go-live for admin setup. We’ll schedule onboarding the week of September 2.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Can you also include the support hours? My VP keeps asking whether email support is included or if that’s extra.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Included. Email support is unlimited for named admins, and the package includes two live training sessions. If you want a third session later, it’s $650, but I wouldn’t add it now unless you know you need it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Fair. Send the order form to me and copy Mark in procurement. If we get it today, I can probably get signature by Friday, August 16.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it over this afternoon with the 42 seats, net 30, one invoice with two line items, and the September 1 start date. Anything else you want reflected before I finalize it?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that covers it. Thanks, Alex.
